### How much are Manchester United tickets?
The price of watching Manchester United play can vary based on several factors.
One such reason is the competition that the team is competing in.
For instance, an early-round FA Cup fixture will likely be far cheaper than a hotly anticipated derby game versus Liverpool in the Premier League.
Another consideration to keep in mind is where you wish to be seated to watch the game(s).
So as for the prices themselves, you can expect to pay anywhere from £100 to £200 upwards.
### Where is Old Trafford?

Found in Old Trafford, Greater Manchester - the home of Manchester United (not mistaken for the Old Trafford Cricket Ground) can best be found opposite the 02 Victoria Warehouse, facing the Hotel Football.
### What is the capacity at Old Trafford?
The second largest football stadium in England (behind Wembley), Old Trafford, can house over 74,000 ravenous fans inside one of the most famous stadiums in world football.
The history of the club, coupled with its atmosphere, makes it one of the most sought-after football venues for fans of the beautiful game.
